### Hospital AI Platform Concept (Architectural Blueprint)

### AI Employment & Skill Matching Concept (Humanitarian Blueprint)

### Autonomous AI Assistant / Jarvis Concept (Experimental Prototype)

## 4. AI Lab Experiments
- **Multi-Agent Collaboration Sandbox**: Benchmarking specialized sub-agents with JSON schema contracts.
- **Claude Code Autonomous Workflows**: Developer velocity through headless terminal agent refactoring and automated test loops.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Machine entity mapping and Schema.org graphs for Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Claude discovery.
- **Local AI Voice Pipeline**: Sub-500ms offline voice loops using quantized local LLMs (Ollama) and local speech models.
- **Physical AI Robotics Bridge**: Vision-language models connecting to ESP32 microcontrollers via MQTT/serial.
- **Dynamic Multi-Model Router**: Adaptive query classification heuristics dispatching between DeepSeek, Gemini, and OpenAI.
